name: daily-dsa-art30-compliance-audit
description: Daily DSA Art. 30 compliance audit — checks all active sellers have complete 5-point trader card data.
prompt: Query database for all active sellers. Verify each has all 5 DSA Art. 30 data points: legal name, postal address, email, phone, VAT number. Flag any incomplete profiles. Suspend listings of non-compliant sellers. Generate compliance report.
